start_here: Say to your AI: "Change my part of the shared draft d1 to 'My part', against the version I read", with {"op":"edit","draft_id":"d1","author":"sample-coauthor-b","expect":"1f:f95f6ea2d42e1aac148d4bd6d2e457a8e584277ce6241fcf9990b6c816291c8c","changes":{"sections":{"sample-coauthor-b":"My part"}}} and the draft you read as stored.draft. It runs tool:edit-a-shared-draft and answers ok true, the new identity 1f:2ab3e7c7b5c3521bb005aa641f4573b85a4087f40d2883cae8a2dde5dc1c66c1 and one write: draft:d1 with your section changed and the edit recorded, to store only while draft:d1 still holds the identity you read.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it takes the draft and approvals the caller read and answers the writes, and the caller keeps them in its own store at draft:<draft_id> and draft-approval:<draft_id>.
instructions: 1. Read the draft from your own store at draft:<draft_id> and note its content identity (1f:...).

2. Say to your AI: "Change my part of shared draft <draft_id> to ..."; it calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:edit-a-shared-draft, op edit, your principal as author, the identity you read as expect and only the fields you change.

3. Read what comes back: ok true with writes to store in order, each only while your store still holds its expect; or a refusal naming the current identity, when nothing was written and you read the draft again.

4. To approve the version you read, run op approve with that identity and keep the approval at draft-approval:<draft_id>; the owner runs op check with every author's approval, and the draft is ready only when every author approved the current identity.
